name: Brawl
description: Make NPC(s) non-lethally brawl the player.
guided_description: Start a non-lethal fistfight with the player. Use when a proud or hot-headed character (Nord warriors, Companions, Battle-Borns, Gray-Manes, drunks) is insulted after one warning, at once if their family or honour is insulted, when a fight they offered is accepted, or when the player swings first. Not for guards on duty, jarls, the old, frail, timid or children.
note: EXPERIMENTAL: Can cause NPC AI packages to break.

source.description: The NPC(s) who will start the brawl.

prompt: If the player picks a fight with you, begin your response with '{key}:'
